title: There seem to be many inconsitancies with the quality - coming back for a second review - have to take off a star
text:
There seem to be many inconsitancies with the quality - coming back for a second review - have to take off a star. Just adding to my review (below). The issue of debris just falling back out of the vacuum has gotten worse. It has always been slightly annoying but no matter how I try to fix the issue, debris constantly falls back out. I have folded the vacuum with it not running, still running, already emptied - nothing works. Debris just dumps back out. So I liked it fine - it was powerful enough for quick jobs but I have to say that the annoyance of having to clean up after the clean up leaves something to be desired.

Original review: I came here to leave a review and to agree with the relatively minor annoyance regarding the bits of debris that fall out of the vac even after it has been emptied. I have had the vacuum for two years and I have found it to be a powerful vac with a long lasting battery. I must admit I have never had another cordless vac so I am not sure what "long lasting" means to other people but I have never had a problem - after all, it is just for cleaning up small messes - it doesn't profess to be a full-fledged vacuum. On another note, I always make sure to plug it back in after I am finished using it so I have never had a problem with the battery running down. My concern is, after reading other reviews, that there is a major inconstancy in the vac's construction - so many varying reviews about battery-life and suction - and it probably should prepare anyone buying this vac that they might end up with one of the "bad" vacs. Personally, I love it. I don't mind that there is no way to hang it up - it just sits plugged in in the corner of the counter - and that is fine with me.

Another key feature is the removable, washable, translucent, bag less dirt bowl - which makes for easy, hygienic cleanup as well as holding 40% more dirt & debris than the original Pivot Vac. Finally, this vac folds in half for compact charging and storage. Imported. Dimensions: Measures 6 wide by 11.125 long by 7 tall/deep
